analytical_role: Documents process entities activities organization and evidence status
systems_modeling_role: Connects formal structure to how a system produces behavior
review_warning: A formal model without mechanism documentation may be descriptive only

analytical_role: Documents equations variables parameters constraints and computational steps
systems_modeling_role: Makes model structure explicit and reviewable
review_warning: Formal consistency does not guarantee explanatory validity

analytical_role: Documents parameter source unit range evidence status and model role
systems_modeling_role: Prevents fitted constants from being mistaken for causal mechanisms
review_warning: Calibrated parameters are not automatically causal quantities

analytical_role: States whether the model is making a causal or mechanistic assertion
systems_modeling_role: Separates formal dependence from causal dependence
review_warning: Functional dependence does not automatically imply causal explanation

analytical_role: Defines the evidence domain purpose and range of model adequacy
systems_modeling_role: Aligns model use with evidence and intended purpose
review_warning: A model can be valid for one purpose and invalid for another

analytical_role: Defines what kind of explanation prediction or decision support is justified
systems_modeling_role: Prevents formal outputs from being overinterpreted
review_warning: Formal structure supports explanation only when mechanism evidence and scope are documented
